role: intersection of historical train folds 0 and 6; reused exploratory development

measurement.scan_rule: nearest native timestamp; earlier time on ties; keep actual timestamp
measurement.velocity_denominator: actual native elapsed time between selected endpoints
measurement.support: all native intermediate samples finite, available, same run, strictly increasing time; known-undetected excluded; unknown detection allowed and counted; no interpolation, gap fill or slot reassignment
measurement.invalid: whole window unsupported; no distance/velocity imputation
measurement.identity: opaque slot only; no person continuity certification

descriptive_metrics.mean_grid: all native timestamps in each interval, equal sample weights
descriptive_metrics.support: complete requested window and trailing history; controls use exact same support
descriptive_metrics.publication: counts, median, q25, q75; no individual curves, coordinates, times or records

selection.eligible: multiples of 10 seconds of clock within each run with [-0.6,+1.5] inside same run; sort (run,nominal_time) before support checks
selection.cap: N<=100 retain all; otherwise indices floor(k*(N-1)/99), k=0..99; no backfill
selection.effective_center: native timestamp closest to nominal grid, earlier on ties, tolerance 0.02 seconds
selection.candidates: A nearest ball within candidate team; C distinct teammate nearest A at center; R opposing player nearest ball; stable slot index ties; no future or H/A selection
selection.independence: one center gives two candidate sets, not independent replicas

controls.initial_proximity: d_A(t), d_C(t), d_R(t) without future motion
controls.uniform_motion: same fixed candidates and ball extrapolated from effective center with trailing velocities at center; evaluate on exact observed native support; report observed-minus-extrapolated changes; no causal interpretation

matching.algorithm: visit chronologically (run,time); same bins; nearest Euclidean standardized initial vector; distinct centers; ties (run,time); no replacement; count unmatched; never relax bins
matching.contrasts: post-minus-pre and late-minus-pre differences, signed chronological later-minus-earlier and absolute, exact common support; no p-values

portability: public original IDSSE datasets required externally; no redistribution of datasets, no new models or caches; local installation/environment still required
